## Description

Briefly describe the changes introduced by this pull request and the motivation behind them.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing API or binary format)
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Tests addition / improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the coding style and guidelines in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have compiled with `-Wall -Wextra` and ensured there are **no compiler warnings**.
- [ ] I have run `make all_tests` and all tests pass.
- [ ] I have checked memory cleanliness with Valgrind where applicable.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README / changelog accordingly.
